feature.paper_changed_surface.summary: A changed Paper node must produce a bounded revalidation surface that continuation consumes.

observable_effect.description: The next continuation plan exposes the exact changed dependency and defeater closure.

feature.paper_continuation_release_capsu.summary: A continuation-descended Candidate Release must consume one content-addressed scoped capsule and reuse its bounded currentness proof at the verifier boundary.

observable_effect.description: Candidate and verifier capsules expose the exact status generation, Paper closure, artifacts, dispositions, and changed Fact interfaces without replaying the full continuation history.

feature.native_successor_topology.summary: The public successor entry must produce and later validate the complete native successor topology binding.

observable_effect.description: Native stage records and native freeze recomputes the complete predecessor topology and premise order before publication.

feature.evidence_pdf_paper_fact_triad.summary: Reviewed PDF, Paper Graph, and imported Fact Graph Evidence must associate through the normal Evidence flow.

observable_effect.description: Evidence status exposes one content-addressed nontruth PDF/Paper/Fact association.

feature.brave_future_goal_intake_binding.summary: An ordinary auto/deep research goal must bind the returned internal Campaign id to future Research without Campaign jargon.

observable_effect.description: New Research created after goal intake carries the exact returned Campaign id.

feature.mathematical_target_policy.summary: Mathematical drafts preserve the exact target, hypotheses, domains, and quantifiers while allowing proof, disproof, or obstruction.

observable_effect.description: Paper preflight rejects mathematical target substitution and accepts the three declared resolution statuses.

feature.cross_domain_continuation_adapte.summary: Normal continuation must select the domain adapter rather than assuming philosophy-style stance preservation.

observable_effect.description: The continuation plan and preflight expose obligations for the exact declared domain profile.

feature.paired_adverse_proof_philosophy_.summary: Historical direct-allocation cards may retain exact paired adverse worker/context bindings, but prospective public production never creates them.
feature.paired_adverse_proof_philosophy_.boundary_reason: Frozen direct-allocation history must remain readable without reactivating paired adverse dispatch in the prospective public Research cycle.

feature.production_supervision_refute_bo.summary: Prospective public production is constructive-only; formal Research refute work begins in the supervision subround and Candidate adverse review remains later.

observable_effect.description: The production manifest contains no refute assignment or adverse pair; admitted Facts remain frozen premises unless exact conflict evidence is separately escalated.

feature.candidate_fresh_adverse_readines.summary: An explicitly selected marked constructive Candidate head must fail cheaply unless one later independent ingested refute binds its exact canonical Candidate Fact bytes and disposition; historical ancestry does not create a new target.

observable_effect.description: Missing, stale, aborted, inherited, or differently hashed adverse work exits before artifact normalization, source audit, capsule construction, or seal.

feature.candidate_preflight_work_elimina.summary: Candidate-local assurance shape and exact current-assurance statement-interface errors fail before global Research replay, and supervision history is loaded only after production provenance is established, without replacing authoritative validation.

observable_effect.description: A locally malformed Candidate or current-assurance statement interface fails from submitted bytes and immutable selected Research envelopes before full Research replay; valid inputs still reach the complete assurance, supervision, source, adverse, seal, verifier, Certification, Gateway, and Fact gates.

feature.reentrant_active_fact_validation.summary: A command-local active-Fact validation reentry consumes only a local immutable projection while the outer frame retains complete authority replay and requires exact agreement.

observable_effect.description: Nested frozen authority checks terminate without a persistent cache or recursion-limit change, while local Release, marker, and Fact bytes are checked immediately and the outer complete projection must match exactly.

feature.selective_fact_admission_checkpo.summary: Main may freeze a bounded explicit load-bearing Research selection and deterministic dependency-closed Candidate authoring batches before expensive Candidate construction, without ranking, atomizing, or truth effect.

observable_effect.description: A checkpoint records exact selected ancestry and dependency edges, propagates selected-premise blockers, emits disjoint dependency-closed authoring batches, requires one semantic conclusion per later Fact plus exact Candidate-DAG closure, and creates no Candidate, Decision, admission, or Fact.

feature.candidate_fact_prepackaging_atom.summary: Prospective Candidate Facts and new candidate_fact worker artifacts fail before expensive replay or ingestion unless they are canonical and expose one semantic conclusion.

observable_effect.description: One-conclusion Candidate bytes continue to ordinary gates; separable conclusions or noncanonical worker bytes fail before global Research replay, packaging, verifier work, or truth effect.

feature.exact_repair_spec_transport.summary: Main may bind one exact bounded repair specification through copy-on-write Research into the immutable production task card.

observable_effect.description: The normalized claim, content, rationale, mode, obligations, and stop conditions are hash-bound in repair Research and visible unchanged in the task card; malformed or drifted input fails closed.

feature.prospective_candidate_adverse_pl.summary: Main can plan one exact Candidate-bound adverse refute without reopening constructive production or bypassing later admission gates.

observable_effect.description: One active non-stale target with one exact candidate_fact binding and an adverse marker creates or reuses one host-scope-bound ordinary refute round with no truth effect; a validated aborted round is excluded before old round or task-card reconstruction.

feature.bounded_candidate_adverse_handof.summary: Main selects one load-bearing Research head and one canonical Candidate Fact regardless of author provenance; every applicable completed supervision result is bound and the refute card selects a dedicated compact bootstrap.

observable_effect.description: One content-addressed nontruth synthesis binds the Main-selected canonical Candidate Fact and every applicable completed supervision result without treating worker authorship as capability; its refute prompt selects the Candidate-adverse bootstrap and never the production bootstrap.

feature.host_scope_attack_coverage.summary: Every completed host task must expose a scope-complete attack report, including an explicit zero report.

observable_effect.description: Host completion status exposes covered cases, pending proposals, and zero/nonzero report state for the exact scope.

feature.concise_attack_route_recommendat.summary: The default Main-facing attack report exposes at most three family-deduplicated concrete worker failure families; workers provide no persistent route text and technical case detail remains behind --full.

observable_effect.description: Main sees concrete failures and boundaries, then may reject or synthesize one compact mechanism-level future rule; worker text is never activated.

feature.production_research_obligation_c.summary: The default production frontier groups only exact executable Research inputs and closes a workgroup through a unique exact copy-on-write terminal with a current valid production result plus every applicable safe supervision result; positive resolution projects back to the original workgroup, while ambiguous, challenged, blocked, adverse, or route-invalidated terminal evidence reopens the work.

observable_effect.description: A uniquely and safely completed exact copy-on-write terminal closes the original workgroup in actionable views while history retains its identity and provenance; terminal invalidation or ambiguous repair lineage reopens it, explicit-ID planning remains available, and a sibling completion race fails before public round bytes.

feature.bounded_frontier_projection_v3.summary: Ordinary and Brave Future frontier views consume the same exact workgroup and completion projection; public entries are compact, and the requested limit bounds entries, the authenticated member window, and related inventories while the full eligible set is retained only as count and digest.

observable_effect.description: Main receives only the requested compact boundary window; work-key, completion, score, and record identity are cross-bound between each v3 entry and its authenticated manifests, while frozen v1/v2 records remain readable.

feature.main_unbound_research_semantic_r.summary: The public Main memory-add path reuses one complete identical unbound Research semantic across actor-label drift while every ordinary, operator, task-bound, and assignment-bound write keeps actor-sensitive identity.

observable_effect.description: A Main retry with identical normalized unbound semantics returns the existing Research identity under the mutation lock; actor text cannot enable reuse and worker provenance is never collapsed.

feature.two_subround_research_supervisio.summary: Prospective Research freezes first-subround logical components and sends sparse scoped supervisors over one exact completed component before Candidate construction, with component-bound cycle-safe full outer validation and lock-held same-host retry.

observable_effect.description: One to three refute-mode supervisors receive hash-bound production outputs; one ephemeral component-bound inspection stack prevents recursive validation without persistent authority caching, retry arbitration occurs under the mutation lock, aborted rounds reserve no scope, and Pulse remains inactive.

feature.failure_informed_selective_resea.summary: Prospective second-subround supervisors are selected from a static append-only registry of reproduced high-loss failure families; blanket proof and same-scope integration review are absent.

observable_effect.description: Only role, artifact, and outcome-applicable supervisors are planned; integration requires distinct primary scopes, and every selected supervisor binds the exact static registry hash and family id.

feature.scoped_supervisor_bootstrap.summary: A current machine-bound second-subround supervisor starts from one compact versioned contract and loads broad source, computation, attack-learning, or CHX-repair protocols only when the exact scope or observed event makes them applicable.

observable_effect.description: The generated supervision prompt selects one manifest-bound compact bootstrap; ordinary production keeps the full public worker contract, conditional broad protocols fail closed, and exact return, runtime, CHX, Candidate, verifier, Certification, Gateway, and Fact boundaries remain unchanged.

feature.research_supervision_candidate_g.summary: A prospective constructive Research result cannot enter expensive Candidate work until every deterministic component supervisor has one live completed ingested result; Candidate sealing rechecks the exact set under its mutation lock, and review records cannot replace the constructive anchor.

observable_effect.description: Missing, pending, duplicate, aborted, wrong-component, or wrong-revision review fails before Candidate expense; the one valid result per scope is automatically included in the release closure and its liveness is rechecked under the seal lock.

feature.logical_component_research_super.summary: Production freezes a deterministic partition from selected Research ancestry and validation authoritatively rederives it; a completed component may be supervised while unrelated workers continue, but related integration waits and timing-derived or overlapping coverage fails closed.

observable_effect.description: One exact component enters scoped supervision before unrelated assignments return; multi-component calls require an explicit frozen component id, exact Research ancestry is reloaded to reject a self-consistent forged partition, and duplicate scope coverage is rejected.

feature.preexecution_computation_code_ga.summary: A first-subround computer returns core code before execution; formal execution consumes only its assignment-local safely disposed, live, non-aborted program-math supervision and identical source/dependency hashes, with a final lock-held latest-disposition and authority check.

observable_effect.description: Execution fails before scheduling without the exact assignment-local safe live disposition; aborted reviews are skipped, the latest disposition and authority are rechecked under the round-write lock, and return preflight rejects source or dependency drift before actual output returns to supervision.

feature.communication_readiness_normal_f.summary: External research communication must consume current lint readiness in the normal release path.

observable_effect.description: The communication path reports readiness or fails before emitting the external artifact.

feature.neutral_review_formal_return.summary: A neutral verifier draft must pass the copied strict preflight before the host can publish an immutable formal review and success receipt.

observable_effect.description: The host exposes draft_written, preflight_failed, preflight_passed, and formally_returned without giving a failed draft Candidate, Certification, Gateway, or Fact effect.

feature.chx_repair_integration_gate.summary: A project-run-local revision-5 resolution consumes prior reconnaissance, one reusable tactical repair, and latest coordinated per-ledger integration; global installation uses the direct global integrated writer with no tactical precursor.

observable_effect.description: Project-local resolution uses its content-addressed per-ledger integration; a global installation is settled directly by the content-addressed cross-ledger global integration.

feature.phx_global_architecture_route_re.summary: Architecture-route and cost-reduction semantics consult one host-global nontruth PHX guide; adoption remains unavailable without supporting evidence and prior informed user authorization.

observable_effect.description: The global guide preserves current and superseded routes, CHX provenance, bounded evaluations, informed consultation and measured adoption without project or truth authority.

feature.operator_fact_evidence_import.summary: Non-paper Fact Graph import remains explicit user plus Operator action.
feature.operator_fact_evidence_import.boundary_reason: Automatic import would transfer external scope into Evidence without the required user decision.

feature.zotero_snapshot_ingress.summary: Zotero snapshot ingestion is an externally supplied library operation.
feature.zotero_snapshot_ingress.boundary_reason: Its activation depends on an external library snapshot and is not a project normal-flow obligation.

feature.parallel_verification_machine_re.summary: Pure protocol construction of one signed machine-verification receipt remains callable without owning project state.
feature.parallel_verification_machine_re.boundary_reason: The V5 capability matrix assigns project persistence to parallel_verification_lifecycle.py; this pure constructor has no project-state or Fact authority and is not an automatic project-flow root.

feature.parallel_verification_aggregate_.summary: Pure protocol aggregation of signed verifier receipts remains callable without owning project state.
feature.parallel_verification_aggregate_.boundary_reason: The V5 capability matrix assigns project persistence to parallel_verification_lifecycle.py; this mechanical aggregate has no project-state or Fact authority and is not an automatic project-flow root.

feature.profile_closure_record.summary: Profile closure remains a callable V4 compatibility advisory surface.
feature.profile_closure_record.boundary_reason: It must stay outside automatic V5 planning and Fact admission.

feature.v4_mode_initialization_transitio.summary: A valid mode-less inherited V4 project may enter current reasoning-mode governance through the explicit public mode-init transition.
feature.v4_mode_initialization_transitio.boundary_reason: The transition is explicit, future-work-only compatibility activation. It must bypass only the ordinary outer lock while ReasoningModeStore retains the dedicated fail-closed transition lock.

feature.v4_execution_profile_auto_attach.summary: Automatic V4 execution-profile attachment is retired; individually preserved V4 compatibility surfaces remain explicit and bounded.
feature.v4_execution_profile_auto_attach.boundary_reason: No current mechanism covers the old panel, Pulse, Paper/Audit, novelty, Campaign, computation, and synthesis bundle as one equivalent automatic profile. File presence must not reactivate it.

feature.structured_source_evidence_seman.summary: Source-scope supervision consumes frozen source capabilities by exact path/hash semantics across graph-era field spellings without rewriting historical records.

observable_effect.description: Every concrete path declared by one source item must be project-contained and byte-equal to its one SHA-256; deterministic path selection then supplies the supervisor capability, while locator-only metadata remains non-authorizing.

feature.structured_source_assurance_acti.summary: Literature mode and structured source/applicability obligations activate exact source-use assurance without depending on incidental logic-signal prose.

observable_effect.description: Applicable returns provide nonempty source_uses keyed to every structured source obligation and bind exact returned or card-authorized primary bytes plus required witnesses; frozen old cards are not rewritten.

feature.active_campaign_implicit_selecti.summary: Implicit selection through the historical ACTIVE Campaign pointer is retired.
feature.active_campaign_implicit_selecti.boundary_reason: Current goal intake and planning require exact objective or explicit Campaign identity and must never consume ACTIVE implicitly.
